meta.title: WoW Forever Warlock spell ranks, every level 1-60

status_legend.forever: Forever client data (build 1.60.1.70862) as carried by wowsims-forever

source.records: sim/core/spelldata/spells_auto_gen.go (wowsims's generator bakes in tools/database/overrides; any override comment is copied to the rank's wowsims_overrides: those fields are wowsims's in-game measurements, not client rows)
source.vanilla: cmangos classic-db spell_template (1.12) for vanilla_* fields, npc_trainer_template 91 + npc_trainer rows of class 9 trainers for vanilla_trainer (teach spell -> learned spell through effect 36 LEARN_SPELL)

formulas.value_at_level: BasePoints + PPL * clamp(min(L, scaling_max_level) - scaling_base_level, 0); scaling_max_level 0 = no cap. Computed in float32 as wowsims Effect.AverageAt. Damage/heal amounts keep the fraction; every other amount is floored.
formulas.cost: cost.mana flat; cost.pct_base_mana = pct of base mana (base_mana table in <class>_levels.json); cost.rage in rage (row value / 10); cost.energy; cost.combo_points_min = the finisher needs at least that many; cost.health (Life Tap row has none: wowsims spends amount + Spirit).
formulas.learn_level: SpellLevels.SpellLevel of the rank (client). learned_from.vanilla_trainer gives the vanilla 1.12 trainer level and cost for comparison. 2 Nov notes: training every class ability 1-60 costs 206-207 gold in Forever, so vanilla costs are not Forever costs.
formulas.vanilla_compare: vanilla.changes_vs_vanilla compares learn level, flat cost, cooldowns and each effect's amount at the learn level (vanilla BasePoints+1 .. BasePoints+DieSides, Forever tooltip range) with the 1.12 row of the same id. A difference of 1 point or less is ignored. Cast times and durations are not compared (the 1.12 rows store index ids into tables not in the local data).
formulas.required_stance_mask: client StanceMask bit field (1 << (form id - 1)); e.g. warrior Battle 17, Defensive 18, Berserker 19; druid Cat 1, Bear 5, Dire Bear 8, Moonkin 31.

coefficient_penalties.finding: Neither wowsims-forever nor mythicsim-forever-engine applies the vanilla sub-20 penalty (1 - (20 - spellLevel)*0.0375) or a downrank coefficient penalty. Ranks learned below 20 carry sp_coef_if_vanilla_sub20_penalty so a sim can switch the vanilla rule on.
coefficient_penalties.forever_notes: kami-labs summary of the 2 Nov 2026 notes: the low-rank penalty was removed from several chance-based talents and stays on Arcane Concentration, Frostbite and Fingers of Frost (proc less often when the rank was learned more than 12 levels below the caster). Nothing in the notes speaks to damage/heal coefficients of low ranks.

forever_class_notes: Curse of Agony and Curse of Doom are Banes; Curse of the Elements covers all magic; Curse of Shadows removed; Life Tap scales with Spirit; demons scale from the warlock's stats (deep dive 7 Oct). 2 Nov notes: demon health 2 per point of warlock Stamina (was 7.5); Spellstone Shadow damage only; Drain Soul shard chance cut.
notes_sources: Warcraft Tavern summaries of Blizzard's Forever class deep dives: Priest & Warrior (1 Oct 2026, Blizzard news 24301514), Mage & Shaman (7 Oct, 24302097), Rogue & Warlock (7 Oct, 24310968); 'All Changes to Paladins' (21 Sep 2026); 'WoW Forever Pre-Launch Class Changes & Bug Fixes' (4 Nov 2026, from Kaivax's Beta Development Notes updated 2 Nov).
Blizzard news 'World of Warcraft: Forever Class Deep Dives - Hunter and Druid' (news.blizzard.com/en-us/article/24301515).
kami-labs 'WoW Forever November 2 patch: 223 changes before launch' (datamined items marked).
The Blizzard forum dev-notes thread itself could not be fetched here (needs approval); its content is taken from the summaries above.
Where a note and a client row disagree, the row wins; the row values are the ones in ranks[].

BaneOfAgony.name: Bane of Agony
notes: Curse of Agony became a Bane in Forever (only one Bane per warlock on a target).

wowsims_code_notes.comment: Bane of Agony's base ramps in thirds: the first third of the ticks at half, the second at the base, the last at one and a half. The spell power share and the damage multipliers are read as each tick lands, and the share does not ramp. Amplify Curse, which the cast spends, raises the whole tick, base and share, for the whole of the Bane it landed with. The share read at each tick comes from the Nov 3 patch notes; the game files do not state it. TODO: Ingame test needed: confirm on live that each tick reads the spell power of the moment.

BaneOfDoom.name: Bane of Doom
notes: Curse of Doom became a Bane in Forever.

wowsims_code_notes.comment: One tick at the end of its minute: the row's period is its duration. TODO: Bane of Doom Effect (18662) summons a Doomguard (11859) for 15s. The tooltip has it come only when Doom's tick is the killing blow, at a chance no row states, and a target dies when its encounter ends its life rather than from a damage event; the sim has no Doomguard either.

wowsims_code_notes.comment: Granted by the Conflagrate talent: ignites the warlock's own Immolate and consumes it, unless Shadow and Flame keeps it burning. The 10 sec cooldown is the row's category cooldown. Needs this warlock's Immolate on the target. Immolate registers after the talents, so it is read here. Roll the damage and to hit, then consume the Immolate unless Shadow and Flame keeps it Calculate expected damage from the row's average hit

Conflagrate hits leave more Shadow damage for 20 sec (1293816), Shadowburn hits more Fire damage (426311), both parsed from their rows at the talent's amount. Effect 2 is both the chance Conflagrate keeps Immolate burning and the chance Shadowburn refunds its Soul Shard, 100% at 5/5. The row's effects are dummies the tooltip reads. The talent's effects 3 and 4 price the buffs at each rank: "increases all Shadow damage you deal by $m3%" and "all Fire damage you deal by $m4%". The buff rows' own 10% does not apply, so each buff parses a copy of its row with the talent's amount.

DemonSkin.name: Demon Skin
notes: See Demon Armor.

wowsims_code_notes.comment: The sacrificed demon grants its effect until a summon cancels it (summonDemon): the Imp 15% more Shadow damage (18789), the Succubus 15% more Fire damage (18791), the Voidwalker mana every 4 sec (18792), the Felhunter health every 4 sec (18790), which does not affect sims. The demon sacrificed before the fight (settled in resolveSacrifice) is sacrificed at the start; casting the talent's spell (18788) sacrifices the demon out. The row states no cast time, cost or cooldown. Auras reset after the reset effects, so the demon sacrificed before the fight is marked here. Fel Energy's A_OBS_MOD_POWER: a share of maximum mana every period while the aura is up, which the parse skips.
Heal for the damage each tick dealt

notes: Forever: progressive Soul Shard chance per tick; 2 Nov notes reduced the no-kill chance greatly.

wowsims_code_notes.comment: Effect 1 (A_CHANNEL_DEATH_ITEM) returns a Soul Shard when the target dies with the channel on it, whoever lands the killing blow. The row's PROC_FLAG_KILL at 0% chance grants nothing itself; Soul Harvest reads that kill. TODO: The tooltip's chance of a Soul Shard from a target Drain Soul damages has no row behind it and is not modelled.
For 15 sec, the next summon casts 5.5 sec faster (effect 1) for half the mana (effect 2), and spends the buff.

A channel on the caster: each second it fires Hellfire Effect at every enemy nearby, and burns the caster for the same, spell power included. An area effect that ticks rolls hit on every tick, and crit unless Hellfire Effect's row bars it. Fired by the channel; hits every enemy in range TODO: The burn on the caster is taken as health lost, not as Fire damage its resistance could reduce. Channel on the caster

wowsims_code_notes.comment: Granted by the Shadowburn talent. The 15 sec cooldown is the row's category cooldown, and the Soul Shard each cast takes the row's reagent. A hit that lands leaves effect 1 (A_CHANNEL_DEATH_ITEM) on the target for the row's 8 sec, and the target dying under it returns a Soul Shard, whoever lands the killing blow. The effect is kept as the time its window ends on each target, not as an aura: an aura's expiry on the target would add a step to every fight and shift the order of the events at that time. The window goes with the target that dies, so the same target enabled again starts without it. Roll the damage and to hit Calculate expected damage from the row's average hit

Conflagrate hits leave more Shadow damage for 20 sec (1293816), Shadowburn hits more Fire damage (426311), both parsed from their rows at the talent's amount. Effect 2 is both the chance Conflagrate keeps Immolate burning and the chance Shadowburn refunds its Soul Shard, 100% at 5/5. The row's effects are dummies the tooltip reads. The talent's effects 3 and 4 price the buffs at each rank: "increases all Shadow damage you deal by $m3%" and "all Fire damage you deal by $m4%". The buff rows' own 10% does not apply, so each buff parses a copy of its row with the talent's amount.

A periodic leech like Drain Life's: each tick heals the caster for what it deals. The row does not mark Periodic Can Crit, so the ticks do not crit.
